correctness.rationale: With probability surface normalization, the addition theorem gives E_l E_l*=(2l+1)G_l/12. The orthonormal antipodal compression doubles the representative Gram block. The even matrix after removing (2l+1)/6 is (1-p)I+pJ; the odd matrix is I+pC where C is the sign matrix of the six equiangular axes. An exact coordinate reconstruction checked C²=5I; its zero trace forces three eigenvalues of each sign. This gives precisely the two levels and multiplicities in each parity. The independent Rodrigues coefficient test reproduces all rank exceptions through l=49. As an independent tail argument, the Laplace integral gives |P_l(t)|≤sqrt(pi/[2l(1-t²)]), so at t=1/sqrt(5) one has 5|p_l|<1 from l=50 onward (using pi<22/7). Together these establish every degree and the sharp threshold 15 without relying on numerical near-zeros. For surjective compatible data the inverse norm is 1/sqrt(lambda_min) and the usual spectral condition number is sqrt(lambda_max/lambda_min); the extreme eigenvalue ratio is its square, as specified in the proof. Both ratios tend to 1 with error O(l^(-1/2)).
residual_risks: Read the Finding's phrase about the extreme ratio using the proof's explicit squared condition number; the unsquared condition number is its square root.
The rank argument uses the analytic tail; the bounded calculations alone do not establish unbounded degrees.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Knowing that an irreducible representation occurs in the domain is not enough to know whether its evaluation on the sample orbit vanishes. A rank for an aggregate gives the dimension of the sum of the evaluation images, not the rank of each exact degree, nor any of the two-level eigenvalues.

originality.rationale: The distinct contribution supported by comparison is the complete exact-degree spectral and rank classification on all six icosahedral axes, with full recovery from 15 and the corresponding conditioning formula. The harmonic-index design cancellations at 8 and 14 are established prior facts and are not credited as novel. The strongest inspected literature is narrower in observable or combines degrees; the strongest indexed site-set matches either change the polyhedron or remove an antipodal pair.
residual_risks: The full historical papers by Cohan and Zheng–Doerschuk were not inspected; an earlier equivalent evaluation formula cannot be ruled out.
The inspected covariance material does not justify a negative claim about the entire paper. This is a bounded originality assessment, not proof of historical priority.

value.rationale: The exact levels give the loss of each compatible data mode at fixed degree and the precise cost of least-norm interpolation when surjective. The complete rank list separates known design cancellations from genuinely permanent recovery; the late failure at 14 despite more than enough input degrees of freedom matters to exact-degree interpolation. The highly symmetric sample set is natural and the induced evaluation map is not covered by a generic dimension count.
residual_risks: Not a result on recovering an arbitrary input harmonic or on combined-degree sampling.
